next_step: Finalize POC SLOs + pricing call w/ finance
notes: Company background: mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) with in-app chat assistant for power users.
Initial ask: evaluate Hosted API for time-to-value, then transition to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation.
POC scope: agentic chat flow that chains multi-step tools: semantic search -> action (create/update ticket) -> follow-up query.
Latency target: p95 <= 350ms end-to-end for streaming tokens; interactive feel for agents is critical.
Tool-calling requirements: reliable orchestration, idempotency guarantees, retries, explicit timeout semantics.
Concern: tool-call timeouts currently result in partial actions; need rollback/compensating steps and better observability.
Streaming + function calling are crucial for UX; want immediate token streaming while tool call executes asynchronously where possible.
Testing plan: 2-week POC on Hosted API with synthetic load (50-100 concurrent agents) followed by 30-day Dedicated eval if SLOs met.
Cost sensitivity: want per-session token cost estimates, impact of batching/quantization, and unit economics at scale.
Security: require SSO via SAML, audit logs, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for specific enterprise customers.
Call notes (2026-02-03): 'need deterministic timeouts and retry backoff — can't have duplicate ticket creation' (quote from Head of Product).
Demo (2026-02-10): SE demoed streaming + tool-call pattern; SE to share sample orchestration code, recommended timeouts, and observability hooks.
Open questions: expected tail-latency under burst, model-fallback behavior when Dedicated pool is saturated, and SLA details for Dedicated.
Next steps: AE to schedule pricing deep-dive with finance; SE to deliver POC runbook, sample orchestration, and stress test plan.
Jira follow-ups: INF-3421 (tool reliability/timeouts), INF-3478 (VPC onboarding checklist).
